verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a graphics card. User-defined event-driven automation rules are a workflow-software axis outside a GPU's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping rule or trigger definitions: G-Assist offers system tuning and control, and RTX Video sharpens automatically, but neither lets users define event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
